svg.data-spec:
title: funcd function callers kind: flow dir: down
[From outside] gray down client: HTTP client | a Route or by name [/] [Over a link] blue down fn2: Another Function | ctx.invoke, ctx.fetch job: A Job's run | ctx.invoke, ctx.fetch [/] [From funcd] amber 2 sensor: Sensor | function action step: Workflow | Function step hook: App | lifecycle hook addon: Add-on | its kind's objects [/]
edge: Edge @blue local: Local API | checks the link @blue chain: Invoke chain | Admit, Before, After @blue act: Activator | wakes a worker @blue workers: Workers | the Function's @blue
From outside > edge Over a link > local edge > chain local > chain From funcd > chain chain > act > workers
